main.description: A vote on a segment name proposal (app.activitytracker.feed.segmentNameProposal). Private: stored only in the voter's interactions space, and the AppView ignores one in a repo or a tier space. It counts only while the voter has an effort on the segment and its subject's CID is the proposal's current version, and the AppView never serves who voted.

subject.description: The proposal, at the version voted on.
